items.title: Office Hours: Back in Vegas Edition
items.author: Brent Ozar Unlimited
items.summary:
Let's go through your top-voted questions from https://pollgab.com/room/brento. Here's what we covered:

00:00 Start
00:52 chris: After your time at SQLBits you’d posted about the number of SQL Server consultants who were very opposed to AI.  What was the feedback you were getting on why folks are against this technology?
03:50 DBAInAction: Hi Brent, what’s your recommended rollback policy for SQL upgrades while maintaining same compatibility? how do you address the data gap that may occur after the go-live and if we need to rollback ? If Leadership requests a formal strategy, how do you structure your response?
05:43 Michael J Swart: You linked to a Tested Q&A: The number of times I've shown a client a gray spray painted piece And I've said this is not for color it's only for form Then the first thing the client says is yeah I just don't like the color What questions like that do you hear too often?
10:35 Niktrs: Hi Bent. Thank you for the spring training. Because time zone difference, I would appreciate it, if you could leave the video recordings available for one day. Thanks in advance
11:30 Hany: Hello Brent, In your website (the Anniversary Sale page) I noticed Google is one of your customers, just wondering, Google doesn`t have a professional database team to fix their issues themselves? 
14:04 TipsyManager: Hola Brent!   You do a good amount of traveling;  any local food (and booze!) that you've particularly enjoyed?   Or particularly hated?
16:05 Will: I know you've stated in the past that you dont like current microsoft SQL certifications, such as the dp-300. Are there any non-microsoft SQL certifications that are respected by employers and actually help certify your knowledge vs just being a marketing gimmick?
17:35 benlinuxguy: Hi Brent. Are you planning to do any Day of Data (former SQL Saturday) at any point in the future, or was last year the last time you did these?
20:42 Luca Carraro (DBA - Doing Business As): Hi Brent, have you ever experienced any performance issues related to the proliferation of DB objects, especially Stored Procedures?

items.title: SQL Server Performance Office Hours Episode 67
items.author: Erik Darling (Erik Darling Data)
items.summary:
In this video, I had the pleasure of diving into some SQL Server questions submitted by viewers during our Office Hours For You session. Erik Darling from Darling Data tackled five intriguing queries ranging from deciding between stored procedures and functions to understanding sorts in SQL Server. We also discussed when batch mode might not be the best choice for your workload. The discussion was engaging, and I hope you found it as enlightening as I did. If you have any more questions or just want to know more about me, feel free to ask away! And if you're interested in my consulting services, training, or becoming a supporting member of the channel, all the necessary links are right there in the video description. Don't forget to like, subscribe, and share with your friends to help grow our community.

CHAPTERS

00:00:00 - Introduction
00:04:08 - Memory Grants and Sorts
00:07:59 - Suspicious Plan Operators
00:10:26 - Batch Mode vs Row Mode
00:12:19 - Conclusion
